unsupported: The Food Processing Center operates in Lincoln, Nebraska, as a university-affiliated resource within the University of Nebraska system.

While its exact founding date is not publicly stated, the center was established to serve as a multi-disciplinary hub for the food industry, drawing on academic expertise to support commercial innovation.
Clients range from startup entrepreneurs to established food manufacturers seeking reformulation, safety validation, or scale-up support.
The center serves the broader food processing sector, providing confidential, fee-based services tailored to each project.

The center emphasizes its staff expertise and the integration of research-grade equipment with commercial practicality, positioning itself as a single point of access for technical, regulatory, and commercialization challenges.
